game_text: Deploy on Galen. While Galen defending a battle, his and Black Leader’s immunity to attrition is +2. May target a character or creature for free. Draw two destiny. If total destiny > defense value, target hit, power -3, and may not be used to satisfy attrition.

base_lore: When Vader dueled Luke at Cloud City, he fought a son trained by his former master and a weapon constructed by his former self.

notes: COMBO / FULL-CARD OVERLAY (755×1098) — a CHARACTER WEAPON printed over the Cloud City USED OR LOST INTERRUPT Weapon Of An Ungrateful Son: the frame changes from the red Interrupt frame to the green Dark weapon frame (with the red diagonal glow at the right, as Decipher's Dark weapons). Title bar: weapon disc (silver weapon with orange/yellow flames on black — the Character Weapon disc; printed: red Interrupt disc); '•Galen’s Lightsaber' (curly ’); destiny 1 (printed 5). LORE BOX PRINTED EMPTY (solid black) → lore '' (printed lore in base_lore). Right of the lore box: Cloud City ring (orange), as printed; no Episode I. ART WINDOW blank white (also covering the right margin / copyright) → art from the printed scan (lightsaber hilt on yellow/purple stripes). Banner 'CHARACTER WEAPON' (spaced caps); no stats, no deploy/forfeit boxes, no icon column (only the diamond-17 set mark); game text 5 lines. Caption '•Weapon Of An Ungrateful Son (V)'. CHANGES vs printed card: type Interrupt → Character Weapon, frame, disc, title, destiny 5→1, lore removed, banner USED OR LOST INTERRUPT → CHARACTER WEAPON, game text replaced (printed: 'USED: If a lightsaber was just used to enhance a Force drain, place it in owner’s Used Pile. LOST: Place any or all of you devices and character weapons on table in your Used Pile.'). Slip text matches the stub (stub straight apostrophe). Base lore matches the 350 px scan (wiki text correct). Base scan only 350 px (CC-D-weaponofanungratefulson.gif); copyright by set (Cloud City 1997). Modern: VB4-D-galenslightsaber-pre.gif (Virtual Block 4 reissue; text names Juno Eclipse). FILES: scans in /tmp/claude-0/h17-d/dl/ — copy to src/vs17/ and src/vs17/modern/.
